description: The codebase renamed storage servers to materializers (lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer*); the guides still say 'Storage' everywhere — file names (data-plane/storage.md), glossary anchors (#storage, transaction-builder.md links to a nonexistent #storage-server anchor), and prose. qzr.6 added a bridge ('called materializers in the codebase') in two places; decide the canonical term and apply it consistently: either rename the docs to materializer (with anchor redirects) or document 'Storage' as the concept name with one prominent note. Also foreman.md still shows :storage as a worker kind in one place; the code's worker_for_kind accepts :log | :materializer only.

comments.text: Closed retroactively: done by #224/#227, which decided on Materializer and applied it. Verified on develop: data-plane/materializer.md exists; zero storage.md / #storage-server / :storage refs remain; the 4 surviving 'Storage' mentions are legitimate (engine implementations, the deliberate glossary bridge entry, and 'Dual Storage Format').

title: Storage vs Materializer terminology pass across all guides
